description: Announce (or renew) this session's presence on the current project — what task/branch/files it is working on. Call this at the start of a work session (e.g. right after build_execute starts a task) so teammates on the same project can see you're on it via session_list, and again whenever what you're working on changes. Advisory only, never blocking. Omit session_id on your first call to get one minted for you; pass it back on every later call so renewals update the same row instead of creating a new one. Does not call the Anthropic API.

branch.description: The git branch this session is on.

files_touched.description: Files this session has touched so far, as YOU know them locally — the server never reads your filesystem.

intent.description: A short free-text note on what this session is about to do.

phase.description: What phase of work this session is in, e.g. "build", "review", "research".

session_id.description: This session's own identifier. Omit on first call — the response returns one to reuse on every later call.

task_id.description: The task this session is currently working, e.g. "task-2071".

worktree.description: This session's own worktree path, as it appears in its OWN environment — never resolved by the server.

name: session_announce
